blocks.text: Sulfur dyes nitro ya amino groups wale organic compounds ki thionation ya sulfurisation se banaye jate hain; products mein sulfur linkages hoti hain. Yeh aam taur par kala, bhoora, khaki, neela aur sabz rang dete hain, misal ke taur par sulfur black 1, sulfur blue aur sulfur brilliant green.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur dyes kaise bante hain, aur woh kaun se rang dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Nitro ya amino groups wale aromatic compounds ko sulfur ya sodium polysulfide ke saath garam kar ke (thionation), jo molecules mein sulfur linkages banata hai; yeh kala, bhoora, khaki, neela aur sabz jaise gehre, saste rang dete hain.

items: Sulfur dyes: nitro- ya amino-compounds ki thionation; sulfur linkages; kala, bhoora, khaki, neela, sabz (sulfur black 1, sulfur blue, sulfur brilliant green).
